SELECT 
	Branch_Location = LEFT(dbo.fn_getpreference('BusinessShortName'), 50),
	VR_Type = 'SSV',
	TR_Type = CASE WHEN S.SaleCatCode = 3 THEN 'CASH' ELSE 'CREDIT' END,
	VR_Date = S.Date,
	VR_No = S.SaleInvCode,
	Sub_Account = NULL,
	Nominal_Account=NULL,
	Party_ID = S.CustCode,
	Party_Name = A.Name,
	Party_Cell_No = C.Phone,
	Bill_No = NULL,
	Bill_Date = NULL,
	Bill_Due_Date = S.DueDate,
	Payment_On_Sale=NULL,
	Gross_Amount = ROUND(SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SalePrice), 0),
	Discount_Amount = ROUND(SUM( (D.LooseQty * D.ItemFlatDisc) +
		(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * D.DiscPerc * 0.01) + 
		(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * S.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 0),
	Tax_Amount = ROUND(SUM( ((D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.UnitSalesTax) +
		(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.GSTPErc * 0.01)) + 
		SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - S.DiscPerc * 0.01) * S.InvGstPerc1 * 0.01), 0),
	Service_Charges = S.MiscCharges - ISNULL(S.AdvanceTaxAmt, 0),
	IncomeTax = ISNULL(S.AdvanceTaxAmt, 0),
	Net_Amount = S.InvTotal,
	Employee_ID = S.SalesmanCode,
	Post_FIS = S.Posted,
	Post_FIS_Date = S.PostDate,
	Post_User = S.PostedBy,
	Post_Time = CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), S.PostDate, 108)
FROM
	SaleLedger S,
	SaleDetail D,
	Customer C,
	Accounts A
WHERE 
	S.Posted = 'Y' AND
	S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
	S.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode
GROUP BY
	S.SaleCatCode,
	S.Date,
	S.SaleInvCode,
	S.CustCode,
	A.Name,
	C.Phone,
	S.DueDate,
	S.MiscCharges,
	S.AdvanceTaxAmt, 
	S.InvTotal,
	S.SalesmanCode,
	S.Posted,
	S.PostDate,
	S.PostedBy
UNION ALL
